name: Chastise
descr:
**Archetype** [Mortal Herald](/archetype/mortal-herald-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-305)

[Fear of God](/feat/fear-of-god-divine-mysteries-feat-feat-7530)

With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe’s fear to see their inner being brought low. You chastise the spirit of a foe within 30 feet that has the [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) condition. The target must attempt a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes 2 [persistent spirit damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core). The first time the creature fails their [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

**Failure** The target takes 4 persistent spirit damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

**Critical Failure** The target takes 6 persistent spirit damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)
descr:
**Archetype** [Rivethun Emissary](/archetype/rivethun-emissary-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-308)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Rivethun Emissary Dedication](/feat/rivethun-emissary-dedication-divine-mysteries-feat-feat-7571)

---

You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice. Select advice or answers.

If you selected advice, choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in today, or an event you might expect to happen today. The spirits share with you a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

If you selected answers, ask two clear and concise questions. The spirits answer your questions. If the question is easy for the spirits to answer accurately, they answer clearly. Otherwise, they answer cryptically, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Regardless of your choice, the spirits additionally bless you, granting you a +1 status bonus with a skill that the spirits believe will be of use to you today. The GM selects this skill on behalf of the spirits. This bonus lasts until the end of the day.

It takes 10 minutes to perform these rites on a willing creature, who must remain within your reach the entire time. Attempt to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) one [curse](/trait/curse) afflicting the creature; your counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and you use either your Occultism or Religion modifier as your counteract modifier. If the curse comes from a cursed item or other external source, a success indicates that the target creature can rid itself of the cursed item, but it doesn’t remove the curse from the item.

name: Domain Spirit
descr:
**Archetype** [Rivethun Emissary](/archetype/rivethun-emissary-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-308)

**Prerequisites**
[Rivethun Emissary Dedication](/feat/rivethun-emissary-dedication-divine-mysteries-feat-feat-7571)

---

You forge an intense spiritual bond of mutual trust and appreciation with a single spirit that you have already bonded with using Bond with Spirit. Forming this bond takes 24 hours of communion, during which time you must remain within 30 feet of the creature or within that terrain. If the creature is intelligent, this also requires that creature’s consent, and that intelligent creature can choose to sever this bond with you at any time as a free action, which has the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait. This spirit is your domain spirit. The bond between you and your domain spirit is not weakened by time or distance, but you can only maintain one such bond at a time, regardless of how many bonded spirits you can maintain.

Select one domain related to your domain spirit. You always have the option to select the [healing](/domain/healing) or [soul](/domain/soul-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-118) domain. If your spirit is a creature, select your domain from the following: [ambition](/domain/ambition), [confidence](/domain/confidence), [family](/domain/family), [might](/domain/might), [protection](/domain/protection), or [trickery](/domain/trickery). You are granted access to your deity’s realm and can travel there quickly. descr:
**Archetype** [Mortal Herald](/archetype/mortal-herald-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-305)

**Prerequisites**
Worshiper of a specific deity; Master in Religion or your deity’s divine skill

---

You become a mortal herald of your [deity](/rule/deity-rules-2048), gaining power in return for your service. Others intuitively sense your connection with your deity, which subtly influences the way they act around you. You become bound by your deity’s anathema. Depending on your deity, their sanctification can make you [holy](/trait/holy) or [unholy](/trait/unholy). This gives you the holy or unholy trait, which commits you to one side of a struggle over the souls of the planes and can be referenced in other abilities. If you “can be” holy or unholy according to your deity, you make that choice, and if you “must be” holy or unholy you gain the trait automatically. If you gain the opposing trait in some way, you lose the previous trait until you complete an [atone](/ritual/atone-player-core) ritual.

In addition, once per day, you can cast [_heal_](/spell/heal-player-core) as a 6th-rank innate divine spell. You can only target yourself with the spell, but you gain the benefits of the 2-action version when you spend 1 action to cast it. In addition, if you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed, you can cast the spell as a free action before you become unconscious. This spell is automatically heightened to a rank equal to half your level.

**Special** If you have void healing, you instead cast [_harm_](/spell/harm-player-core).

You gain the edict “hunt down those who have harmed innocents or committed heinous atrocities.” When you see a creature harm an ally, an innocent, or a noncombatant, you can invoke your oath against that creature. Like speaking, this doesn’t require an action. Most champions choose to invoke these oaths out loud if they’re able. This doesn’t prevent you from healing such a creature with _lay on hands_ if you so choose.

Your knowledge of Razmir’s faith and doctrines has grown. You excel in debating priests of rival faiths, wielding truths as subtly and deftly as any charlatan might wield a lie. When you use Deception to [Lie](/action/lie-player-core), you can carefully structure your deceits so that each individual statement you make is the truth, from a certain perspective. As long as you are wearing your [Razmiri mask](/item/razmiri-mask-divine-mysteries-equipment-equipment-3593), you don’t take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to the [_ring of truth_](/spell/ring-of-truth-player-core) spell or similar effects. Whenever you are subject to _ring of truth_ or a similar effect, you can attempt a Deception check when you first begin speaking to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) the spell’s effects, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up); succeeding at this check doesn’t end the spell or effect, but it does cause it to indicate that you are speaking the truth, even when you are actually lying, as you weave a web of words so delicate that even you can’t be certain where the truth ends and deception begins.

You’re a practicing Rivethun emissary, skilled at interacting and bonding with the spirits of living creatures. You become an expert in Diplomacy and Religion. You also gain the Bond with Spirit activity and the [_entreat spirit_](/spell/entreat-spirit-divine-mysteries-spell-spell-2432) focus spell. Forming this bond takes 10 minutes, during which time you must remain adjacent to the creature or within that terrain. If the creature is intelligent, this also requires that creature’s consent, and that intelligent creature can choose to sever this bond with you at any time as a free action, which has the concentrate trait. You gain the service of a [young animal companion](/rule/young-animal-companions-rules-2114), which has been blessed by the spirits of this world. name: Splinter Faith
descr:
---

Your faith in your deity is represented in an extremely unusual way that some might call heretical. When you select this feat, you should detail the fundamental tenets of your splinter faith, though it shouldn't affect the deity's edicts or anathema. Choose four domains. These domains must be chosen from among your deity's domains, your deity's alternate domains, and up to one domain that isn't on either list and isn't anathematic to your deity. Any domain spell you cast from a domain that isn't on either of your deity's lists is always heightened to 1 rank lower than usual for a focus spell. For the purpose of abilities that depend on your deity's domains, the four domains you chose are your deity's domains, and any of your deity's domains you didn't choose are now among your deity's alternate domains.

**Special** Unless you take this feat at 1st level, changing the way you relate to your deity requires retraining, as described in the [Changing Faith](/rule/changing-faith-divine-mysteries-rules-rules-3350) section. If you take this feat and previously benefited from any effect that requires a domain your splinter faith doesn't include, such as a domain spell from [Domain Initiate](/feat/domain-initiate-player-core), you lose that effect.

At the GM's discretion, you can take this feat with other classes or archetypes that gain access to domains through a deity.
.

name: Stand for the Fallen
descr:
**Archetype** [Mortal Herald](/archetype/mortal-herald-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-305)

**Prerequisites**
[Mortal Herald Dedication](/feat/mortal-herald-dedication-divine-mysteries-feat-feat-7528)

**Trigger**
An ally takes damage that would bring them to 0 Hit Points.

---

You protect your allies at the cost of your own blood, but your deity shields you from the worst of the harm. [Stride](/action/stride-player-core) twice to be adjacent to the triggering ally.

You can [Burrow](/action/burrow-player-core), [Climb](/action/climb-player-core), [Fly](/action/fly-player-core), or [Swim](/action/swim-player-core) instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type. You then take the damage that would have brought your ally to 0 Hit Points, though you gain [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) to all damage against that damage equal to your level.

name: Text Decoder
descr:
**Archetype** [Palatine Detective](/archetype/palatine-detective-divine-mysteries-archetype-archetype-306)

**Prerequisites**
[Palatine Detective Dedication](/feat/palatine-detective-dedication-divine-mysteries-feat-feat-7557)

---

Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings. You can always use Occultism or Religion when you [Decipher Writing](/action/decipher-writing-player-core), no matter the subject matter. In addition, you can ignore language constraints when Deciphering Writing, and when you critically fail to Decipher Writing, you get a failure instead.
